log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf+Hatterene lead: Armor Tail blocks Fake Out, Magic Bounce reflects TWave/Will-O-Wisp, both set Trick Room. Kingambit+Gardevoir back: Kingambit threatens Chandelure with STAB Kowtow Cleave and cleans with Supreme Overlord; Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice destroys Garchomp and Mystical Fire handles Klefki. Opposing Chandelure's Imprison can block TR but we punish it with Dark attacks.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Brought Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks Fake Out, Psychic 4x OHKO on Sneasler but Sash saves), Hatterene (Magic Bounce reflects status, secondary TR), Kingambit (late-game Supreme Overlord cleaner, Kowtow Cleave 2x on Chandelure ~99-188%), Mega Gardevoir (Pixilate Hyper Voice 2x on Garchomp, Mystical Fire for Klefki). Watch for Chandelure Imprison blocking TR. Opposing Klefki screens can't be bounced—use Gardevoir Mystical Fire or Kingambit pressure. Sneasler has Focus Sash + Unburden; needs double-target to KO through Sash.

decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler+Chandelure to immediately Imprison Trick Room vs Farigiraf/Hatterene and Throat Chop Pixilate Hyper Voice. Sneasler CC/Gunk covers Kingambit and Fairies, Chandelure resists Fairy/Fire. Back Garchomp+Klefki for Levitate EQ spam and screens vs Mega Gardevoir spread.
decisions.notebook: Opp core is Armor Tail TR into Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Kingambit/H-Arcanine. Chandelure Imprison+TR is hard counter and must be preserved. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out so need Throat Chop to silence Hyper Voice and CC for Farigiraf. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic and sets screens. Garchomp+Rotom Levitate enables EQ vs Kingambit/H-Arcanine. Sneasler Unburden+Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf uses Protect to avoid possible KOs from Sneasler Gunk Shot + Chandelure Heat Wave. Hatterene switches to Kingambit, which is immune to Sneasler's predicted Gunk Shot (Poison) and resists Throat Chop. Chandelure likely uses Imprison, which we cannot prevent, so preserving both setters for a later TR after removing Chandelure is key. Kingambit provides a favorable matchup into Chandelure afterwards.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Sneasler (Sash Unburden) + Chandelure (Mental Herb, Imprison/TR). Our leads Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Mental Herb) + Hatterene (Magic Bounce, Life Orb). Chandelure Imprison blocks TR; we must KO it to enable setup. Turn 1: Farigiraf Protect, Hatterene switched to Kingambit. Plan: KO Chandelure with Farigiraf + Kingambit pressure, then set TR with Farigiraf. Hatterene preserved in back to set secondary TR if needed. Kingambit immune to Gunk Shot, resists Throat Chop/Shadow Ball, but 4x weak to Close Combat. Sneasler likely to target Hatterene slot with Gunk Shot. Keep Armor Tail's Fake Out immunity while Farigiraf alive. Gardevoir can mega later.

decisions.rationale: Imprison goes before Trick Room (-7) and blocks both setters while Chandelure lives. Sneasler Gunk Shot is guaranteed OHKO vs Hatterene (103-192%) removing one TR setter; Fake Out is blocked by Armor Tail. Sash protects Sneasler from 4x Psychic.
decisions.notebook: Opp is Armor Tail TR into Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Chandelure Imprison+TR is hard counter must stay alive. Sneasler Unburden+Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens. Garchomp EQ pairs with Levitate. Throat Chop blocks sound moves.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit Protect blocks Sneasler's likely Close Combat OHKO. Farigiraf Psychic guarantees OHKO on Sneasler (4x weak). Farigiraf eats a Heat Wave (~25-41%) but survives easily. Next turn we double Chandelure to remove Imprison and unlock Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Sneasler (Sash/Unburden) + Chandelure (Mental Herb, Imprison/TR/ShadowBall/HeatWave, Flash Fire). Our leads Farigiraf + Hatterene switched Kingambit T1. Imprison blocks our TR; must KO Chandelure first. Turn 2 plan: Protect Kingambit + Psychic OHKO Sneasler; then T3 double Chandelure. Hatterene and Gardevoir-Mega in back for secondary TR and late-game sweeping. Opponent backline: Garchomp (Life Orb, Jolly), Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate).

decisions.rationale: Sneasler CC is guaranteed OHKO vs Kingambit (128-267%) removing 2x Dark threat to Chandelure. Chandelure Heat Wave is 51-113% vs Kingambit and hits Farigiraf. Sneasler Focus Sash survives Farigiraf Psychic (4x) to proc Unburden. Imprison already blocks opposing Trick Room, so maintain offense.
decisions.notebook: Opp core is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Chandelure Imprison hard counters TR and must be preserved. Sneasler Unburden + Focus Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens. Garchomp EQ pairs with Chandelure immunity. Throat Chop blocks sound moves vs Gardevoir/Farigiraf.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch +1 priority beats Sneasler's Close Combat, KOing it at 1% before it can OHKO Kingambit. Farigiraf Psychic into Chandelure deals 32–59%. If Sneasler Fake Outs Kingambit, Farigiraf still lands Psychic; if Fake Out targets Farigiraf, Sucker Punch still KOs Sneasler. Both outcomes leave us 2v1 vs a weakened Chandelure with Imprison soon to fall.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Sneasler (Sash/Unburden) + Chandelure (Mental Herb, Imprison/TR/ShadowBall/HeatWave, Flash Fire). Our leads Farigiraf + Hatterene switched Kingambit T1. Imprison blocks our TR; must KO Chandelure first. Turn 2: Protect Kingambit + Psychic OHKO Sneasler; Sneasler at 1% with Sash consumed. Backline: Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate HyperVoice) and Hatterene (TR, Life Orb) for secondary TR and late-game. Opponent backline: Garchomp (Life Orb, Jolly), Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate).

decisions.rationale: Sneasler CC guarantees OHKO Kingambit (128-267%) before it can Kowtow Cleave Chandelure (74-157% OHKO risk). With Kingambit removed first, Chandelure Heat Wave becomes single-target vs Farigiraf (34-78%) to likely finish 64% Farigiraf. This preserves Imprison to block TR.

Both foes under 30% HP. Garchomp Rock Slide KOs Kingambit 15% and Farigiraf 26% burn, while Klefki cannot KO and leaves Chandelure 50% exposed to super-effective Kowtow/Sucker. Next turn Protect Chandelure + Rock Slide secures board and keeps Imprison vs TR.
decisions.notebook: Opp is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Chandelure Imprison is hard counter and must be preserved. Sneasler Unburden Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens. Garchomp EQ pairs with Chandelure immunity only when Chandelure Protects; otherwise use Rock Slide. Throat Chop blocks sound moves.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch (+1) outspeeds both foes and guaranteed KOs Chandelure from 49%, removing Imprison so Hatterene can set TR. Switching Farigiraf to Hatterene preserves the giraffe and puts a fresh TR setter on field. Kingambit is sacked to Garchomp EQ, but Chandelure's removal unlocks our TR win condition.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent leads Sneasler (Sash/Unburden) + Chandelure (Mental Herb, Imprison/TR/ShadowBall/HeatWave, Flash Fire). Our leads Farigiraf + Hatterene switched Kingambit T1. Imprison blocks our TR; must KO Chandelure first. Turn 2: Protect Kingambit + Psychic OHKO Sneasler; Sneasler at 1% with Sash consumed. Turn 3: Sucker Punch KO'd Sneasler; Psychic hit Chandelure to 49%. Backline: Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate HyperVoice) and Hatterene (TR, Life Orb) for secondary TR and late-game. Opponent backline: Garchomp (Life Orb, Jolly), Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate). Turn 4: Switch Farigiraf→Hatterene, Sucker Punch KO Chandelure to remove Imprison. Supreme Overlord at 1 stack (1.1x).

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf 26% brn dies to Garchomp Dragon Claw (27-62% guaranteed). Kingambit Sucker Punch is priority and would KO 50% Chandelure if Chandelure attacks (75-130%). Using Chandelure Imprison status makes Sucker Punch fail, so Garchomp goes next and KOs Farigiraf before its Psychic (41-73%) can hit Chandelure. Preserves Imprison vs TR.
decisions.notebook: Opp is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Chandelure Imprison hard counters TR and must stay active; switching loses Imprison. Sneasler Unburden Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens. Garchomp EQ only with Chandelure Protect/switch because EQ OHKOs Chandelure. Throat Chop blocks sound. Kingambit Sucker Punch fails vs status moves, so use status on Chandelure to dodge.

decisions.rationale: Hatterene Protect avoids all damage while Kingambit Sucker Punch targets Chandelure. If Chandelure attacks, Sucker Punch OHKOs it at +1 priority, removing Imprison. If Chandelure uses status (Trick Room/Protect), Sucker Punch fails but Hatterene is safe; next turn under possible TR we still move first and can OHKO Chandelure with Psychic. Kingambit may fall to Rock Slide but the Imprison block is the game-deciding factor.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent Chandelure has Imprison blocking our Trick Room. Removing Chandelure is top priority. Opponent backline: Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate). Our backline: Farigiraf (26% brn, TR) and Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate HyperVoice). Once Imprison is gone, Hatterene sets Trick Room to sweep. Kingambit Supreme Overlord currently 1 stack (1.1x).

decisions.rationale: Send Gardevoir at full HP. Gardevoir-Mega (152 Spe Modest) outspeeds Chandelure (max 145) and applies Pixilate Hyper Voice pressure. Hatterene Psychic OHKOs Chandelure from 49% (guaranteed KO), which removes Imprison and unlocks Trick Room. Farigiraf at 26% brn is too fragile and would likely faint before acting.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent Chandelure has Imprison blocking Trick Room. Removing Chandelure is top priority — Hatterene Psychic OHKOs it from 49%. Once Imprison is gone, Hatterene sets Trick Room. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate) outspeeds Chandelure and can pressure both foes. Opponent backline: Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate). Our backline: Farigiraf (26% brn, TR). Kingambit Supreme Overlord was 1 stack (1.1x).

decisions.rationale: Kingambit at 15% is KO range for Garchomp Dragon Claw (10.6-22.3%). Chandelure at 50% dies to Sucker Punch (68-117% max) if it attacks, but Sucker Punch fails vs status. Use Imprison status to blank Sucker Punch aimed at Chandelure while Garchomp removes Kingambit. Keeps Imprison active to deny TR.

Double-target Chandelure with guaranteed KO moves. Hatterene Psychic (57.5% min > 49% remaining) and Mega Gardevoir Psychic (51.5% min > 49%) both OHKO Chandelure from current HP. Chandelure moves first but can only KO one of our mons; the other finishes Chandelure, removing Imprison and enabling Trick Room next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Chandelure has Imprison blocking Trick Room. Removing Chandelure is top priority — once it faints, Hatterene sets Trick Room. Opponent backline: Rotom-Mow (Sitrus, Timid), Klefki (Light Clay, Bold, screens+TWave), Arcanine (Leftovers, Adamant, Intimidate). Our backline: Farigiraf (26% brn, TR). Kingambit fainted (Supreme Overlord was 1 stack). Gardevoir-Mega has Pixilate Hyper Voice as spread Fairy nuke.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp Protect blocks double Fairy spread that would KO it (Hatt + Gardevoir Dazzling Gleam). Chandelure Shadow Ball super-effective vs Psychic/Fairy, best chance to OHKO Mega Gardevoir threat while Imprison keeps TR blocked. Keep Chandelure alive at all costs.
decisions.notebook: Opp is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Hatterene TR Life Orb. Chandelure Imprison hard counters TR and must stay active; switching loses Imprison. Sneasler Unburden Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens. Garchomp EQ only with Chandelure Protect/switch because EQ OHKOs Chandelure. Throat Chop blocks sound. Kingambit Sucker Punch fails vs status. Farigiraf low brn, Gardevoir mega Pixilate is main spread threat.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Chandelure's Imprison is gone, so Trick Room is finally available. Gardevoir at 21% dies to any Garchomp Rock Slide roll (30.8-44.1% into ~30 HP), so Protect is mandatory. Hatterene sets TR safely at -7 priority, taking 25.8-36.4% from Rock Slide. Next turn under TR, slower Hatterene moves first, Gardevoir second, both before foes. Opponent has no backline, so KOing Garchomp leaves only Klefki.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Chandelure's Imprison is gone. Opponent brought only 4 mons (Sneasler, Garchomp, Klefki, Chandelure). Sneasler and Chandelure fainted; only Garchomp and Klefki remain. No backline. Once Garchomp falls, win is near. Trick Room is now settable. Gardevoir has Pixilate Hyper Voice as Fairy spread nuke. Farigiraf (26% brn) and Hatterene (100%) remain. After Trick Room set, aim to KO Garchomp with combined Dazzling Gleam + Hyper Voice next turn.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Garchomp)
decisions.rationale: Gardevoir at 21% -1 SpD is in Rock Slide range and Dazzling Gleam range. Double Fairy spread threatens Garchomp at 90%. Prankster Light Screen goes first and halves both Hyper Voice and Dazzling Gleam, preserving Garchomp which outspeeds both foes. Rock Slide gives best chance to KO Gardevoir while damaging Hatterene; Protect is reduced and risks losing Garchomp.
decisions.notebook: Opp core is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Hatterene TR Life Orb Magic Bounce. Chandelure Imprison hard counters TR but is gone after KO. Sneasler Unburden Sash outspeeds Noivern after proc. Klefki resists Fairy/Psychic for screens, Light Clay extends. Garchomp EQ OHKOs Chandelure so needs Protect/switch. Throat Chop blocks sound. Kingambit Sucker Punch fails vs status. Magic Bounce reflects Thunder Wave and status at Hatterene, Armor Tail blocks priority vs Farigiraf.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room: Hatterene (44) → Klefki → Gardevoir (128) → Garchomp. Dazzling Gleam + Pixilate Hyper Voice both hit Garchomp super-effectively. Even through Light Screen, the combined minimum (~90.5%) exceeds Garchomp's 80% HP, guaranteeing the KO. Gardevoir may fall to Klefki or Garchomp afterwards, but eliminating Garchomp leaves only Klefki, which Hatterene can handle.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Only Garchomp and Klefki remain. Chandelure and Sneasler fainted. No opposing backline. Trick Room active (4 turns). Once Garchomp is removed, Hatterene sweeps Klefki. Farigiraf (26% brn) in back for emergency TR reset.

decisions.rationale: Light Screen halves special. Gardevoir at 21% dies to Rock Slide 22-54% but could Protect before Garchomp in TR. Prankster TWave on own Garchomp halves its Speed to ~84, making it move before Gardevoir in Trick Room, so Rock Slide hits Gardevoir before its Protect can go up. Also improves Garchomp's TR order for remaining turns.
decisions.notebook: Opp is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Hatterene Life Orb Magic Bounce TR. Magic Bounce reflects status aimed at Hatterene. Armor Tail blocks priority vs Farigiraf. Chandelure Imprison counters TR. Sneasler Unburden Sash. Klefki Light Clay screens resists Fairy/Psychic. Garchomp fast bad in TR, can be slowed by own TWave to move earlier in TR and bypass Gardevoir Protect timing.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, Klefki (95–127 Speed) moves before Gardevoir-Mega (128). Gardevoir at 21% with -1 SpD risks being KO'd by Klefki's Dazzling Gleam before it can attack. Protecting Gardevoir guarantees it survives while Hatterene chips Klefki through Light Screen. Next turn both can attack; Mystical Fire threatens a 2HKO and the SpA drop improves longevity.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Only Klefki remains. Under Trick Room, Gardevoir-Mega (128 Spe) is faster than Klefki (95–127) in normal conditions, so Klefki moves first in TR — Gardevoir must Protect or switch when facing Klefki under TR. Hatterene (44 Spe) always moves before Klefki under TR. Farigiraf (26%, brn) is a last-resort TR resetter. Light Screen up for 6 more turns.

decisions.rationale: Klefki Dazzling Gleam is only damage option; with Gardevoir at 21% and -1 SpD it has KO chance despite spread, while Light Screen halves incoming Mystical Fire + Dazzling Gleam letting Klefki survive. TWave into Hatterene bounces via Magic Bounce and TWave into Gardevoir makes it faster in TR.
decisions.notebook: Opp core is Armor Tail Farigiraf TR + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Hatterene Life Orb Magic Bounce TR. Magic Bounce reflects status aimed at Hatterene. Armor Tail blocks priority. Klefki Light Clay screens resists Fairy/Psychic. In TR slower moves first; paralyzing self via bounce can make Klefki move earlier in TR but risks full para.

decisions.rationale: Double into Klefki. Hatterene Psychic (14.95–28.4% through Light Screen) + Gardevoir Mystical Fire (29.9–56.8% through LS) = 44.85–85.2% combined minimum > Klefki's 39% HP. Guaranteed KO if both attacks land. Only risk: Prankster Thunder Wave para on Hatterene (25% full para) or Dazzling Gleam KOing Gardevoir before it moves (18–33.6% with -1 SpD vs 21% HP). Highest-probability line.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Klefki is the last foe. Under TR, Hatterene (44 Spe) moves before Klefki (95–127), Klefki moves before Gardevoir-Mega (128). Prankster Thunder Wave has +1 priority and outspeeds all. Farigiraf (26% burned) is emergency TR resetter. Light Screen halves special damage. Combined Psychic + Mystical Fire through LS guarantees KO on Klefki if both connect.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Klefki at 40% with Light Screen can survive both spread hits (~10-18% total). Dazzling Gleam has KO chance vs 21% Gardevoir-Mega at -1 SpD and leaves 29% Hatterene in low range, reducing to 1v1 vs burned Farigiraf. TWave vs Hatterene bounces and risks full para with no damage; TWave vs Gardevoir does no damage now. Immediate damage maximizes win prob in TR.

TR 1 turn left, Hatterene (44) and Farigiraf (72) both move before Klefki (95–127). Armor Tail blocks Prankster Thunder Wave. Two Psychics into Klefki through Light Screen: Hatterene 14.95–28.4% + Farigiraf 8.25–15.55% = 23.2% min > 14% HP. Guaranteed KO before Klefki acts.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Armor Tail blocks Prankster priority from foes. Light Screen + resistances make Klefki bulky; combined special attacks still break through. Remember to always calc with Light Screen halving after tool estimates.

decisions.rationale: Hatterene at 1% dies to Dazzling Gleam. Thunder Wave to Farigiraf is blocked by Armor Tail due to Prankster priority, and Thunder Wave to Hatterene bounces via Magic Bounce self-paralyzing. Dazzling Gleam also chips Farigiraf (26% brn) for possible KO and secures Hatterene removal before TR ends.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side, Mental Herb; Hatterene Magic Bounce reflects status, Life Orb; Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Klefki Prankster TWave is priority and thus blocked by Armor Tail when Farigiraf active. TWave at Hatterene bounces. Light Clay screens halve damage. Burn on Farigiraf halves physical but not special.

reflections.summary: Eliminating Chandelure early with a critical-hit Psychic from Mega Gardevoir prevented it from using Imprison to block Trick Room, allowing Hatterene and Gardevoir to sweep under Trick Room despite Light Screen.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, expect the opponent to better protect Chandelure or lead with Sneasler for Fake Out pressure. Lead with Farigiraf to block Fake Out via Armor Tail and set Trick Room safely, or pair Hatterene with a faster attacker to eliminate Chandelure before it can use Imprison.
reflections.notebook: Game 1: Armor Tail blocks Prankster priority from foes. Light Screen + resistances make Klefki bulky; combined special attacks still break through. Remember to always calc with Light Screen halving after tool estimates. Opponent's Chandelure is an Imprison user to stop Trick Room; they will likely try to protect it. They may bring Arcanine for Intimidate to weaken Kingambit. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Fake Out and Prankster status moves when fielded.

reflections.summary: Lost preview plan: brought fast frail core Sneasler/Garchomp + single-point Imprison Chandelure vs hard TR double spread (Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Hatterene Life Orb Dazzling Gleam/Psychic). Chandelure died T6 to crit Psychic before it could block TR, Hatterene set TR T7 freely, then under TR spread overwhelmed Garchomp/Klefki even through Light Screen. No Mega brought to match Mega Gardevoir, and Klefki Prankster TWave is dead into Armor Tail Farigiraf / Magic Bounce Hatterene.
reflections.adjustment: Next game abandon fast Sneasler/Garchomp mode into their TR. Bring bulky Steel/Fairy resists and two TR answers - double-target Hatterene before TR, keep Chandelure alive with Protect/Fake Out support, or bring own TR setter to reverse. Do not rely on Prankster TWave vs Farigiraf/Hatterene. If we have a Mega, bring it to trade with Mega Gardevoir.
reflections.notebook: Opp TR core confirmed: Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb Trick Room/Psychic/Hyper Voice/Protect Sassy - blocks priority vs its side; Hatterene Magic Bounce Life Orb Quiet Trick Room/Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Protect; Mega Gardevoir Modest Pixilate Hyper Voice/Psychic/Mystical Fire/Protect; Kingambit Adamant Black Glasses Supreme Overlord Kowtow Cleave/Sucker Punch/Iron Head/Protect - early sac. Game1 they did NOT bring Hisui Arcanine Sitrus Intimidate Flare Blitz/Rock Slide/Close Combat/Protect or Noivern Focus Sash Infiltrator Tailwind/Draco/Heat Wave/Protect - expect Tailwind or Intimidate pivot next game. Burn halves Farigiraf physical only. Need non-priority speed control and spread resists.
